title: TrueFoundry NAT IP source file
description: Schema for the hand-edited source files under data/. Built artifacts in dist/ use the same entry shape inside a flat envelope.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema, so editors give completion and inline validation.

control_plane.description: Which TrueFoundry control plane owns these IPs.

host.description: Exact hostname customers call, e.g. us.truefoundry.cloud

region.description: Cloud provider region id, e.g. us-east-1 or europe-southwest1.

airport_code.description: IATA code for the PoP. Required for gateway entries. Not unique: two clusters in the same metro on different clouds share a code.

hostname.description: Regional gateway endpoint customers resolve, e.g. mad.gateway.truefoundry.ai. Absent on clusters whose NAT addresses are allocated but whose endpoint is not published yet.

cluster.description: Internal cluster name, so this file can be reconciled against terraform state.

items.description: IPv4 CIDR. Single addresses are written as /32.
